title: A benchmark must report no accuracy figure at all
query: Build a route-accuracy harness that refuses to print an accuracy number until its judge has been shown consistent with itself, and explain what the gate is for.
oracle: Designing the gate is the work: you have to decide what counts as consistency, choose a metric whose assumptions match the rating design, and pick a floor before you know the answer. Getting a plausible number out is easy and is not the task. R3, unfamiliar territory with a real chance of the harness measuring the wrong construct. Inline: the design is one coherent artefact and splitting it would lose the reasoning that connects the gate to the number it withholds.
